description: Resolve an upstream repo URL, owner/name, or artifact id to one Hugging Bay artifact id plus its hosted/download/mirror actions. To get a file: resolve_artifact -> deployment_plan (or GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/download-plan) -> pick the files[] row whose path names the quant you want (e.g. Q4_K_M) -> GET its downloadUrl -> compare the local SHA-256 with its sha256. The license is on the artifact record (license / licenseId); only rows with a downloadUrl are downloadable (serveVerdict READY).
name: resolve_artifact
